aggregation.descriptive_consensus: For each component, divide mean_abs_SHAP(feature) by the sum of mean_abs_SHAP across retained features; then average the two normalized shares with weights 0.5/0.5.
aggregation.warning: Consensus normalized importance is descriptive and must not be called exact SHAP for the probability-averaged ensemble.

cohort.sampling: without replacement from frozen validation membership

method: TreeSHAP computed separately for each component model.
per_model_importance: mean absolute SHAP over the frozen cohort
purpose: Quantify proxy absorption after removal of shortcut-prone features.
retraining: NONE; use frozen models from Stage23 primary/placebo runs
